subject: Re: Change order request — capacity add + invoice proration

Date: 2027-05-02T09:17:00-07:00
Subject: Request: mid-month capacity add + proration for May invoice

Hi Sergio —

Thanks for the walk-through yesterday. Procurement wants to move forward with an immediate capacity add: +2x dedicated GPU units starting mid‑May. They specifically asked for:

- A formal change order (tracked changes preferred) that amends the existing Order Form and Exhibit A (SOW) to reflect the additional capacity and revised throughput commitments.
- A clear invoice proration for May since the new capacity would start 2027-05-15; we want a single, consolidated invoice that shows the prorated charge for May plus the full-month charge for June.
- Clarification in the SOW on how we measure "committed throughput" (metering window and rounding rules).

I've attached our annotated SOW with comments (Nova_October_SOW_redlines.docx). Procurement has asked for the change order and final paperwork by COB 2027-05-05 to hit their internal PO cutoffs.

Can you confirm next steps and whether Redwood can provide an invoice proration schedule and a draft change order this week?

Best,
Maya
Maya Riddle
Senior Procurement Manager, NovaCorp

Maya —

Thanks for the detail and for sending the marked-up SOW. Happy to move quickly on this. Quick notes:

- We can produce a tracked change change‑order that amends the Order Form + Exhibit A. I'll draft the change order and share a first pass this afternoon.
- For proration we typically pro-rate to the day and show the calculation line (daily rate x number of active days in the billing month). We can also provide a one-line credit if you prefer a reconciliation approach on month 1.
- For the SOW metering language, looping in Olga (Legal) to propose an explicit clause for rounding and measurement windows.

Laura — can you confirm the pricing band and per-GPU monthly fee for the +2 units so I can populate the numbers?

I'll attach our internal template for change orders so you have the expected format.

Thanks —
Sergio
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
Attachment: Change_Order_Template_v3.docx

Date: 2027-05-02T11:15:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-month capacity add + proration for May invoice

Sergio / Maya —

Confirming pricing: +2 dedicated GPU units at rate band B = $18,750 per GPU / month (MSA Exhibit B rate). For proration we recommend:

- Use a daily-proration formula: (monthly unit price / 30) * active days.
- If start date is 2027-05-15, charge 16 days of May (inclusive) = (18,750/30)*16 per GPU.
- Show the proration line as "Prorated charge (2027-05-15 to 2027-05-31)" and then show full month amounts starting June.

Two quick items to watch:
1) If Nova wants billing aligned to number of active GPU-hours rather than calendar days, that will require a different metering clause in Exhibit A and may affect the quoted rate.
2) If procurement needs a net-30 invoice dated the first of the month, we can issue a consolidated invoice dated 2027-06-01 that includes the prorated May line and the June charges; let us know preferred invoice date.

I'll leave wording suggestions to Olga for the SOW clauses.

—Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: sergio_alvarez@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: Maya Riddle <maya.riddle@novacorp.com>, NovaCorp Procurement <procurement@novacorp.com>
Date: 2027-05-03T09:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: mid-month capacity add + proration for May invoice

Sergio / team / Maya —

Thanks for the thread and the draft SOW redlines. I reviewed the attached document and propose the following high‑level edits (I'll send a marked PDF):

1) "Committed Throughput" — add explicit definition: measurement window = rolling 5‑minute sample; monthly reconciliation uses daily aggregation; rounding: round up to nearest whole billing unit (1 GPU-hour).
2) "Billing Unit & Proration" — add clause: "Charges for any partial billing period shall be prorated on a daily basis using a 30‑day month; charges will be rounded to the nearest dollar."
3) "Change Orders and Effective Dates" — include language that the change order's effective date is the start date listed in the change order, and invoicing may be consolidated at the discretion of the customer provided payment terms are met.

I attached a redlined PDF with phrasing suggestions and a short comment asking whether Nova requires an NDA addendum for the increased capacity data flow.

Next steps:
- Sergio: populate the pricing numbers and I'll drop the tracked SOW edits into the change order template.
- Maya / Procurement: confirm whether you prefer calendar-day proration (recommended) or usage-hour proration so we can finalize Exhibit A.

Attachment: SOW_markedup.pdf

Regards,
Olga Petrov
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
From: Maya Riddle <maya.riddle@novacorp.com>

All —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. Procurement confirms calendar-day proration and a consolidated invoice is preferred (invoice dated 2027-06-01). Start date confirmed: 2027-05-15.

If you can send the tracked change change order and the consolidated invoice schedule by COB 2027-05-05, we will route for the PO and signature. We do not need a separate NDA addendum at this time.
